biotools.summary: The COVID-19 Real World Data Infrastructure (CRWDi) is a U.S. government resource linking and harmonizing real-world data to study the impact of COVID-19, particularly in immunocompromised patient populations. The dataset contains data on 5.2 million people and is freely available to approved researchers.
